How They Handle Restricted Countries

Conventional platforms use country-based blacklists. If your IP or bank is flagged, you’re locked out. Stripe and PayPal’s restrictions are not bugs—they’re features designed to minimize corporate risk. Workarounds like VPNs or proxy accounts violate terms of service and risk permanent bans. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack bypasses this entirely. It’s built on decentralized infrastructure. GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Workers are globally accessible. NOWPayments processes crypto without KYC or geographic restrictions. Your customers pay in USDT, BTC, or SOL. The payment verifies on-chain. The product delivers instantly. No middleman. No geographic bias. The system works in Lagos as well as it does in London.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Conventional platforms charge 5-10% per transaction. Add currency conversion fees. Add payout delays. The real cost? $197 for deployment. After that, the infrastructure is yours. No recurring fees. No revenue share. The system is designed for regions where conventional finance fails.

Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Conventional platforms own your data. They control your customer relationships. They can suspend your account without warning. Your business lives at their mercy. Payment verification and product delivery are automated via webhooks. A customer pays. NOWPayments confirms the transaction. Cloudflare Workers sends the download link. No manual intervention. No platform dependency. The system runs 24/7 without you. The tradeoff? You’re responsible for maintenance. The reward? No one can take your business offline.
